title: Program Banner
prompt:
Implement `void program(void)` printing exactly:

```
=== CJ BANK ===
 "Trusted C" 
==============
```

Line 2 contains a leading space, the quoted words (with real `"` characters), and a trailing space.

tests.name: exact banner
tests.hint: Use \" for the quote characters; mind the leading/trailing spaces on line 2.
